claims: As of March 2026, Jai Lucas is the head men's basketball coach for the University of Miami Hurricanes.
Jai Lucas was hired in March 2025.
Jai Lucas was hired following the retirement of Jim Larrañaga.
Jai Lucas previously served as an assistant and associate head coach at Duke University.
Jai Lucas led the 2025-26 University of Miami Hurricanes to a 25-8 record.
Jai Lucas led the 2025-26 University of Miami Hurricanes to a #7 seed in March Madness
